title: Rename the moeb run command to remove ambiguity with run artefacts
description: moeb run is ambiguous: it refers both to the CLI command that executes a spec and to the run artefacts produced by that execution (run files, run IDs, run state, run metrics). This causes confusion in documentation, signals, error messages, and conversations — for example it is unclear whether 'run failed' refers to the command or the artefact being in a failed state.
proposed_resolution: Rename the moeb run CLI command to a less ambiguous name. Candidate: moeb execute or moeb apply. Update all CLI help text, documentation, skill files, README references, and signal proposed_resolutions that mention the run command. Maintain a deprecated moeb run alias for one major version with a deprecation warning printed to stderr. Ensure the renaming is reflected in all agent-facing prompts so agents do not invoke the old name.
